findings.issue: WITHHELD a required R762 diagnostic: a non-constant enumerator initializer violates R762, gfortran diagnoses it, and frozen LFortran crashes - so it had to ship, not stay pending.
findings.resolution: Shipped as a one-property negative (PARAMETER removed from the operand) with a conforming control.

findings.issue: SEVEN manifests ran the SAME program with the SAME four feature mutants, counting 27 mutants as 189 and leaving facets without facet-specific evidence.
findings.resolution: Distinct sources and assertions per manifest; honest mutation count 64.

findings.issue: The author RELAXED the batch-era enum_value generator's pending-partition invariant to fit the shared catalogue; a probe deleting an unowned pending facet went uncaught.
findings.resolution: Restored as a union invariant over the enum_value and enum_type generators; the unowned-deletion probe is now caught by both.

adjudications: The enumerator kind is processor dependent (a NOTE describes one C_INT route), so KIND(enumerator) == C_INT is correctly NOT asserted.
Named enum type facets stay pending because gfortran rejects the syntax.
